sloka: इक्षूंश्च मधुलाजांश्च भोजयन्ति स्म वाहनान् ।इक्ष्वाकुवरयोधानां चोदयन्तो महाबला: ॥ २.९१.५५॥
transliteration: ikṣūṁśca madhulājāṁśca bhojayanti sma vāhanān ।ikṣvākuvarayodhānāṁ codayanto mahābalā: ॥ 2.91.55॥

translations.english: Some women with beautiful eyes quickly approached them for massaging. The best of ladies wiped their bodies dry and gave each other wine to drink.
